paragraphs.text: One Reality Fracture Commander deck will be released together with Reality Fracture on October 2, 2026.

The "Multiverse Reforged" deck introduces 18 new-to- Magic cards alongside 88 reprints. Lead designer Gavin Verhey explained that made only one deck focusing on the villain of the set and with an interesting mechanic, because experience had taught them that was what the public preferred over common returning themes. The team knew that a single Reality Fracture deck had to be truly unique to stand out, which is how they landed on the rare color combination and unique deck archetype. Verhey also hinted that the Commander deck is where Wizards could explore characters who can't appear in the main set due to the two paired Echoverse cards required for boosters. The limitation also allowed access to characters that are already dead in Magic's canon.
1 ready-to-play deck of 100 Magic cards 18 new-to- Magic cards, including 2 traditional foil cards
A deck with a focus on polymorph effects and tokens, exiling tokens to cheat out large creatures.

Like the main set, the deck includes color-shifted cards, which have similar designs to iconic cards from previous sets but in different colors. However, unlike color-shifted cards in Planar Chaos which violated the mechanical color pie with color bends and breaks , these cards feature larger design changes to best fit the new adopted color.
